coverageScope.rationale: User decision 2026-06-29 (option b): scope the coverage gate to the changed/Phase-2 testable-logic files rather than the whole project. Thresholds unchanged (40/45/35/40, absolute). The 3 visual-QA React shells touched by Phase 2 (src/App.tsx, src/components/Preview/Preview.tsx, src/components/StatusBar/StatusBar.tsx) are excluded as rule-10 case-by-case component rendering (not unit-tested logic) — consistent with the plan + design-review posture. Whole-project coverage remains a separate pre-existing baseline concern. The vitest.config.ts exclude-glob fix (target/**, .claude/**, configs, specs) is retained.
